notes: Oracle-layout baseline: predicted bboxes are copied verbatim from the ground-truth annotation. Covers 6 of 8 LTB v0.1 language pairs (en-es, en-de, en-zh, en-ar, en-ja, en-fr). en-th and en-ms are NOT supported by DeepL — they appear as n=0 on the leaderboard, surfacing a real commercial coverage gap in SE Asia and ASEAN markets. The true DeepL Documents API runner (operating on PDFs) is deferred to v0.2 because the v0.1 sample dataset is PNG-based. Total characters processed: ~7,000 across 30 doc x lang-pair batches, comfortably inside DeepL's free-tier 500k chars/mo quota.
